subject: Observability onboarding: signal ops playbook, error taxonomy & alert routing
messages:
From: Ruth Gomez <ruth.gomez@glowhealth.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: [GlowHealth] Observability onboarding - quick context and ask

Hi Maya + Neha,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. We're getting ready to kick off Redwood for our inference platform next week and I wanted to share a short list of priorities so we can align the onboarding scope:  

- Visibility: dashboards for throughput, p50/p95 latency, and token-level cost per model variant.
- Tracing: want end-to-end trace hooks from request -> model shard -> cache.
- Errors: need a clear error taxonomy (model failures, infra OOMs, quota rejects).
- Alert routing: most alerts should land with our oncall team, but severity 1 must page Redwood SRE and our infra lead.

Attached is our current alerts export (small sample) and a proposed oncall matrix. Can we run a short workshop next week to sketch the runbook and agree thresholds? Ideally we capture: who is paged, who owns mitigation steps, and a clear fallback model mapping.

Simon from BrightMetrics will join for dashboard templates — copying him.

Appreciate any pre-reads you recommend.

Thanks,
Ruth
Ruth Gomez
Head of Platform Ops | GlowHealth

Attachments: glowhealth-current-alerts-export.csv (CSV, 28KB)
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Ruth Gomez <ruth.gomez@glowhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [GlowHealth] Observability onboarding - quick context and ask

Hi Ruth — great summary and thanks for the export.

We can do a 90-minute workshop to build: an error taxonomy, alert severity mapping, initial dashboards, and a runbook outline. My suggested agenda:  

1) 15m: goals + success criteria (who should be paged for what)
2) 25m: review GlowHealth alert samples + map to taxonomy
3) 25m: dashboard and trace hook checklist (what to instrument)
4) 20m: runbook decisions + owner assignments
5) 5m: next steps and deliverables

Pre-reads: I'll share a short Signal Ops checklist (attached) and a one-pager on recommended trace points for Redwood inference (will link after this thread).

Proposed slots: Wed 2027-05-26 10:00-11:30 PT or Thu 2027-05-27 14:00-15:30 PT. Which works for you and Simon?

Best,
Maya
Senior Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: signal-ops-checklist-v0.3.md (Markdown, 6KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [GlowHealth] Observability onboarding - quick context and ask

Maya / Neha — quick note on thresholds and runbook content:

- For model OOMs we typically create a Severity 1 if the same model errors > 3 times in 5 minutes OR if a production route hits >30% error rate for 2 consecutive minutes.
- For quota rejects (429/RateLimit) those are Severity 2 unless they cause >10% user-impact.
- Suggested runbook entries: detection query, immediate mitigation (e.g., roll back variant, increase batch size, switch to fallback model), and who to notify (SRE, Product, Customer Eng).

I'll bring a short snippet of our prebuilt Mitigation Playbook to the workshop so we can adapt it to GlowHealth flows.

Ben
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Ruth Gomez <ruth.gomez@glowhealth.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Simon Lee <simon.lee@brightmetrics.io>
Date: 2027-05-21T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [GlowHealth] Observability onboarding - quick context and ask

Thanks Ben — that severity guidance looks reasonable. Wed 5/26 10:00 PT works for us.

Two quick asks before the workshop:  
1) Can you share the short mitigation playbook Ben mentioned as a pre-read? (Even a 1-page example helps.)
2) We run a central PagerDuty; what's the recommended mapping from Redwood alert severity to our PD escalation policy? Do you support webhook-based routing into our existing escalation?

Simon — do you want to propose a baseline dashboard template we can glance at in advance?

Thanks,
Ruth
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ruth Gomez <ruth.gomez@glowhealth.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-21T12:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [GlowHealth] Observability onboarding - quick context and ask

Hi all — looping in from CS to confirm outcome ownership and timelines. Our goal for the workshop is to deliver:

- A draft error taxonomy (CSV) that maps observed alerts to severity and owners.
- A dashboard wireframe in BrightMetrics that covers latency, errors, model variants, and cache hit rate.
- A runbook skeleton with immediate mitigations and exact PD targets (who to page and when).

We typically expect the follow-ups to land within a 5-business-day window post-workshop: runbook v0.1, dashboard v0.1, and an action item list with owners.

Maya — please send the mitigation playbook and Redwood's PD integration notes before EOD Tuesday so Ruth's team can review.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Ruth Gomez <ruth.gomez@glowhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Great — workshop is confirmed for Wed 2027-05-26 10:00-11:30 PT. Quick checklist and links (pre-read pack attached):

- Mitigation playbook (one-pager): Mitigation_Playbook_v1.pdf (attached)
- PD integration notes: our webhook -> PagerDuty mapping (link below)
- Signal Ops checklist (attached)

PD routing summary (short):

- Redwood Severity 2 -> PagerDuty: GH-Prod-P1 (pages oncall only after 10m sustained).
- Yes, we support webhook-based routing; we'll provide a sample webhook payload and a small runbook snippet for your PD integration.

Pre-reads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-signal-ops-onboarding

Action items before workshop:

- Redwood: share Mitigation_Playbook_v1.pdf and sample PD webhook (done, attached).

Looking forward to the session — we'll capture the runbook draft live and circulate v0.1 within 48 hours.

Best,
Maya
Senior Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference
